description: Going close circle, Prolly the best choice for such a small project.
summary: Echoes of Exploration is a 10-question interactive quiz about the robotic and human hardware left on the Moon and Mars, from Surveyor 3 and Apollo landing stages to the Spirit, Opportunity, InSight, and Ingenuity missions. It turns mission history into a short lesson on how these relics still matter to science and why they should be preserved. The quiz gives instant feedback and a final score.
details: Echoes of Exploration is an interactive quiz about the robots and hardware humans left on the Moon and Mars, including Surveyor 3, Apollo landing stages, and the Spirit, Opportunity, InSight, and Ingenuity missions. It explains what these machines did, why they still matter to science, and why they should be preserved. Users answer 10 questions and get instant feedback and a final score.
